summary: Smoke test of imported SMAN 1 Laguboti project. 17/17 backend pytest assertions passed. Login works for seeded super admin (boassibarani123@gmail.com). Dashboard renders with school name/logo. Navigation to Informasi Sekolah (/school-info), Pengaturan (/settings), Inventaris (/inventory), Pemilu OSIS (/elections) all load correctly. SMTP email/test returns graceful 400 'SMTP belum dikonfigurasi' (no crash). AI /api/ai/quiz-generate degrades gracefully with empty OPENAI_API_KEY (503). All 4 cron endpoints (attendance-reminder, attendance-auto-alpha, attendance-archive, kas-reminder) correctly reject without bearer (401) and succeed (200 {ok:true}) with bearer + X-Webhook-Id header. File upload returns /api/files/<path>; file is served to authenticated session (200 image) and blocked for anonymous (401). Gallery POST correctly 403s for super_admin (RBAC allows kepsek/staff_tu/ketua_osis only) — see note below.

minor.issue: super_admin role is NOT in require_roles('kepsek','staff_tu','ketua_osis'). Super Admin cannot upload gallery items directly. Likely intentional per RBAC, but worth confirming because user flow says 'Informasi Sekolah -> edit -> upload gallery image' which admin cannot do.

action_items: Decide whether POST /api/gallery should allow super_admin. If 'Informasi Sekolah → upload gallery' is accessible to super admin in the UI, backend RBAC must include 'super_admin' in require_roles for /api/gallery, /api/gallery/{gid} PATCH and DELETE.
The 2 console 401 errors on first page load before login are from /api/auth/me probe — harmless, but can be silenced by catching 401 in the auth bootstrap.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5262 lines (monolith) — recommend splitting into routers (auth, users, classes, attendance, gallery, cron, ai, email) for maintainability.
Many endpoints use require_roles('kepsek','staff_tu', ...) WITHOUT including 'super_admin'. Super Admin should typically be a universal override — verify RBAC consistency across modules.
/api/files download endpoint supports ?auth=token query param; token is logged in access logs by default (security consideration). Prefer cookie-only for sensitive files.
seed_data_creation: No TEST_ prefixed records persisted (gallery create was 403 for super_admin; uploaded test.png file remains in db.files but is 1x1 PNG — negligible).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully functional for imported project. SPA uses English-ish paths (/school-info, /settings, /inventory, /elections, /quizzes, /schoolgram), NOT Indonesian paths. Deep-linking a non-SPA path renders blank (SPA 404 fallback) — only test via sidebar nav clicks. Cron secret in backend/.env is WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET (used in test). Super Admin RBAC gap for /api/gallery POST/PATCH/DELETE is pending main-agent decision.
